name: synthesia
summary:
Step into a world where you don’t just hear the music—you see it. Synthesia is a captivating musical puzzle game designed for VR, inspired by the fascinating phenomenon of "synesthesia" where senses blend and colors emerge from melodies.
In Synthesia, players hone their musical ear by solving a series of visually and aurally immersive puzzles. Listen to a captivating tune and then rearrange blocks representing sounds and shift notes up or down to match the melody.
